comment: MINIMAL CONFIG - For Vercel Hobby Plan (2 daily crons max). Schedules are UTC; Asia/Manila = UTC+8.

crons.comment: Day-before appointment reminders at 09:00 Manila - MOST CRITICAL for reducing no-shows
Closes the clinic day at 23:00 Manila (queue entries, unattended appointments)

note: Backups are not a cron job: use MongoDB Atlas snapshots or scripts/backup/backup.sh. For additional automation, use external schedulers (n8n, GitHub Actions) calling /api/cron/* with Authorization: Bearer $CRON_SECRET. If any clinic uses webhooks, schedule /api/cron/webhook-deliveries every 5 minutes that way, or failed deliveries are never retried.
